_comment: Merge these three vault hooks into the `hooks` object of your ~/.claude/settings.json. Do NOT paste this file wholesale over settings.json if you already have other hooks — merge each array. Replace {{CLAUDE_DIR}} with the absolute path to your .claude directory (e.g. C:/Users/you/.claude), using forward slashes. `node` and `python` must be on PATH; if not, replace them with absolute exe paths. On non-Windows, keep the same shape — just adjust the interpreter paths.
